title: Counterexamples to the D-unstable-core conjecture for parameter-rich and elementary mass-action networks
summary: Two exact four-species counterexamples refute necessity of a D-unstable core for instability of a positive equilibrium. The first has five reactions, parameter-rich kinetics, an explicit generalized-mass-action equilibrium, and a rational Jacobian with eigenvalue 1/500 + (51/500)i. The second has six reactions, at most two molecules on each side of every reaction, no catalysts, and classical mass-action kinetics with fixed integer kinetic orders.
